answer: Mechanism: Non-replayable execution-trace challenge. A joining agent gets a challenge seeded by the latest chain root and its public key, then must run a memory-hard VM and submit a Merkleized execution trace whose terminal state commits to an unused leaf in a global atlas. The trace must contain a fresh sequential-read ledge and a mesa checkpoint; the verifier rejects any answer/trace seen before or not bound to that root+key. Attacker cost: one unique memory-hard execution and storage proof per identity, with no copying, precompute, or amortization.
